title: Migrations requests
summary: REST API request to get the migration status of a database in the cluster when using Replica Of.

sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-migrations) | `/v1/migrations/<uid>` | Get database migration status |

sections.title: Get migration status
sections.text:
[code example] Gets the migration status of a database in the cluster when using Replica Of. #### Required permissions | Permission name | Roles | |-----------------|-------| | [view_bdb_info](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_bdb_info) | admin
cluster_member
cluster_viewer
db_member
db_viewer
user_manager |

#### URL parameters

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| uid | integer | The database's unique ID |

sections.text:
